# KipFire

> KipFire is an iPhone and iPad app that gives people short prompts to film for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. It is built for people who want to post but don't know what to post, including beginners who are nervous about filming themselves. KipFire uses AI to write the prompt; the user films the video, so the content stays human.

Key facts:
- Categories: Funny, Challenges, Questions, Would You Rather, Hot Take, Inner Me, plus For You (all formats around a chosen niche)
- How it works: open the app, get a random card, film your reaction with the card text on the video, post it
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Price: free to start. Guests get 5 tasks a day in Funny and Challenges. A free account gets 10 tasks a day and all six categories. Premium removes the daily limit.
- Privacy: videos stay on the user's device and are never uploaded
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (App Store). Android coming soon
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kipfire/id6755289956
